title: PeopleSearchBench: Evaluating AI-Powered People Search Platforms with Criteria-Grounded Verification
abstract: arXiv:2603.27476v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI-powered people search platforms are increasingly deployed for recruiting, sales prospecting, and professional networking, yet no standardized benchmark exists for their rigorous evaluation. We present PeopleSearchBench, an open-source benchmark comprising 119 multilingual queries across four scenarios: corporate recruiting, B2B sales prospecting, expert search, and influencer discovery. A central contribution is Criteria-Grounded Verification, an evaluation methodology that decomposes each query into explicit, independently checkable criteria and verifies each returned individual via live web search, producing factual relevance judgments rather than subjective LLM-as-judge scores (Cohen's kappa = 0.84 with human annotators). translated_title: PeopleSearchBench：基于标准锚定验证的AI驱动人物搜索平台评估
translated_abstract: AI驱动的人物搜索平台正日益被部署于招聘、销售线索挖掘和职业社交等场景，但目前尚无标准化基准可对其进行严格评估。我们提出了PeopleSearchBench，一个开源基准，包含119个多语言查询，涵盖四种场景：企业招聘、B2B销售线索挖掘、专家搜索和网红发现。其核心贡献是“标准锚定验证”，这是一种评估方法，将每个查询分解为明确且可独立核查的标准，并通过实时网络搜索对每个返回的候选人进行验证，从而产生基于事实的相关性判断，而非主观的LLM-as-judge评分（与人工标注者的一致性达Cohen's kappa = 0.84）。我们从三个互补维度——相关性精确率、有效覆盖率和信息效用——评估了四个架构各异的平台，并发现多源搜索智能体显著（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个用于评估AI人物搜索平台的开源基准PeopleSearchBench，其核心创新“标准锚定验证”方法通过将查询分解为可独立核查的标准并结合实时网络搜索验证，实现了客观、可复现的事实性评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PeopleSearchBench, the first open-source benchmark for evaluating AI-powered people search platforms, whose core innovation, Criteria-Grounded Verification, decomposes queries into independently checkable criteria and verifies candidates via live web search to enable objective and reproducible factual evaluation.
